name: Okiuchi Tatsuya
source:
Satoru's best friend and friend of the sisters. He is reliable and helpful. He likes Ami.

[spoiler]In Ami routes, he convinces her to have sex with him after she has a fight with Satoru.
In Tsubaki route, he blackmails her and makes her have sex with several men.[/spoiler]
